name: Kormek's Hut
summary: Willow and Bibbly F'utzbuckle make their home at Kormek's Hut in north-central Desolace. The ramshackle dwelling shelters Willow, a peaceful cultist, and Bibbly, a goblin intent on harvesting kodo bones.

sections.title: A Strange Oasis of Oddities
sections.body:
In north-central Desolace, you may find Willow and Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut. The name belongs to someone whose identity and whereabouts remain unknown. Willow sits inside, a member of the usually hostile and nihilistic Twilight's Hammer, yet she welcomes outsiders calmly.

Outside, a pen strewn with sun-bleached kodo bones is Bibbly's dance floor and work site. The excitable goblin sees profit in gathering the bones.

faq.answer: No one knows who Kormek was. The hut bears that name, but neither Willow nor Bibbly explains it, and Kormek is nowhere to be found in the wastes.

faq.q: Why is there a friendly Twilight's Hammer cultist here?
faq.answer: Willow lives inside the hut and belongs to the Twilight's Hammer, a cult usually hostile to all mortal life. For reasons of her own, she does not attack travelers who visit the remote shelter.

faq.q: What is the goblin outside doing?
faq.answer: Bibbly F'utzbuckle dances around a pen filled with kodo bones. He hopes to turn the ancient desert remains into profit.
Kormek's Hut sits in north-central Desolace, in the dry flats north of the central crossroads and cemetery grounds.
